topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna reduces the effective radiated power (ERP) by 59%, necessitating a 1.44 dB increase in transmit power. This amplifies interference and power consumption, impacting system efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Optimizing for both efficiency and performance is crucial to minimize these impacts. The increased transmit power also introduces more thermal noise in the receiver, further degrading link quality and necessitating advanced noise reduction techniques. To balance antenna efficiency, transmit power, and receiver noise, optimizing antenna design and employing sophisticated noise management strategies are essential. This trade-off highlights the importance of careful optimization in satellite communication systems.
